log: Baseline: defined the goal framework (FRAMEWORK.md), requirements catalog (173 items from the stores' own numbering), synthetic benchmark (72 cases) and labeled real-app benchmark (14 apps); built the scorecard

AAB manifest decoding (aapt2 protobuf, verified against Google's own compiled schema on 6 real bundle manifests), APK decoding verified on a real APK, missing targetSdk defaults to minSdk (verified in Android docs), build/outputs artifacts now scanned, base-module-only for bundles
Framework change: added a 'file-format readers verified' sub-metric (10% of D2) with framework/readers.json

Manual checklist feature (--checklist, GUI tab): lists all 63 requirements that need a human/console/running app and all 66 not yet checked, for the stores in scope; moved requirements.json into the package

Packaging and CI: pyproject.toml (stdlib only, console scripts storecheck and storecheck-gui, package data), 3-OS x 2-Python GitHub Actions workflow, installed-copy check in the scorecard; portability fixes: finding paths are POSIX on every OS, all file reads force UTF-8, patches written as bytes

Verified the two remaining file-format readers against independent references on real data: ELF alignment vs readelf and pyelftools on 5 real libraries; PNG/JPEG sizes vs Pillow on 78 generated and 274 real images (0 mismatches). Removed a circular import between checks and checks_extra.
